analysis.summary: Indo Tech Transformers Limited reported robust financial and operational results for FY2026, highlighted by ₹782 Cr in revenue, ₹93 Cr in PAT, and an executable order book of ₹1,318 Cr. Management outlined a phased capacity expansion plan targeting 50,000 MVA by FY29 with a total capex of ₹495 Cr. The company continues to maintain high capacity utilisation between 80% to 90% and strong financial resilience with near-zero net debt and positive cash reserves. Indo Tech Transformers Limited released its investor presentation for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, reporting full-year FY26 revenue of ₹782 Cr and PAT of ₹93 Cr. Management highlighted high capacity utilization of 80-90% alongside an executable order book of ₹1,318 Cr.
